Services

What the workshop does

From the workshop’s own flyers and from what customers describe on Google.

Service and repairs

Regular servicing and repairs. One customer writes that the workshop also took care of the MOT.

Car A/C service

A/C refrigerant recharge with the workshop’s own machine, and cabin disinfection against viruses and odours, as its flyer lists.

Diagnostics

Faults found and explained. Reviews mention an electrical issue on a Range Rover and problems others could not fix.

Pre-purchase check

Before you buy a used car: full OBD system scan, fault codes, live data, component tests and a vehicle health report.

How customers describe a visit

Taken from what customers write in their Google reviews.

Explained first

Five reviews say the mechanics explained what was wrong and what needed doing. One customer got a cost estimate that was kept.

Honest advice

Eight reviews call the workshop honest, transparent or trustworthy, including advice not to spend money where it would not help.

Fair prices

Twelve reviews call the prices fair, reasonable or affordable.

A workshop in Larnaca

Performance Auto Service works at Sfiggos 10 in Larnaca. Its own flyers name expert service, car A/C service and a pre-purchase check with an advanced scan tool, under the line “We check. You decide.” Customers write about everything from a first car to a Porsche.

What customers say

Three of 96 Google reviews, all 96 with five stars.

“Highly recommend this Service station. The mechanic is very professional, friendly and fast. He was very thorough with his diagnostic for my car and explained what my car's issues were and what parts needed changing and why.”
